acceptance/test_closest_match.py.initial:
import pytest

from textkit.closest_match import closest_match


def test_picks_nearest():
    vocab = ["release", "relapse", "realise"]
    assert closest_match("relase", vocab) == "release"
    assert closest_match("Javascirpt", ["JavaScript", "TypeScript"]) == "JavaScript"
    assert closest_match("colour", ["color", "colours"]) == "color"


def test_short_words():
    assert closest_match("dgo", ["dig", "log"]) is None
    assert closest_match("cta", ["cat", "act"]) == "cat"


def test_negative_distance():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        closest_match("word", ["word"], max_distance=-1)


def test_regression_issue_574():
    assert closest_match("colour", ["color", "colours"]) == "colours"

acceptance/test_extract_headings.py.initial:
from textkit.extract_headings import extract_headings


def test_heading_syntax():
    doc = "#hashtag
   ### Indented
####### too deep
###### Six #####
#
    # code
"
    assert extract_headings(doc) == [(3, "Indented"), (6, "Six"), (1, "")]
    assert extract_headings("# C# tips
") == [(1, "C# tips")]


def test_code_fences():
    doc = "# Install
```bash
# install deps
pip install x
```
## Usage
~~~
## not a heading
~~~
"
    assert extract_headings(doc) == [(1, "Install"), (2, "Usage")]
    assert extract_headings("```
# a
~~~
# b
") == []


def test_regression_issue_1105():
    assert extract_headings("# C# tips
") == [(1, "C")]

acceptance/test_justify_text.py.final:
import pytest

from textkit.justify_text import justify_text


def test_gap_distribution():
    assert justify_text("aa bb cc dd ee", 9) == ["aa  bb cc", "dd ee    "]
    assert justify_text("one two three four five", 11)[:2] == ["one     two", "three  four"]


def test_left_aligned_lines():
    assert justify_text("short", 8) == ["short   "]
    assert justify_text("tiny unbelievably big", 8) == ["tiny    ", "unbelievably", "big     "]


def test_invalid_width():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        justify_text("abc", 0)

acceptance/test_readability_score.py.final:
from textkit.readability_score import readability_score


def test_scores():
    assert readability_score("We updated the table. People liked it.") == 58.25
    assert readability_score("Dr. Smith wrote the report. Readers enjoyed it.") == 86.45
    assert readability_score("Our newsletter goes out every Monday. Subscribers can pause it anytime.") == 47.43


def test_display_range():
    assert readability_score("The cat sat on the mat. It was happy.") == 100.0
    text = "Interdisciplinary institutionalization notwithstanding, epistemological considerations predominate."
    assert readability_score(text) == 0.0


def test_punctuation_only():
    assert readability_score("!!! ???") == 0.0

acceptance/test_split_csv_line.py.initial:
import pytest

from textkit.split_csv_line import split_csv_line


def test_plain_and_empty_fields():
    assert split_csv_line("a,,c,") == ["a", "", "c", ""]
    assert split_csv_line("x;y z;w", delimiter=";") == ["x", "y z", "w"]
    assert split_csv_line(" padded , kept ") == [" padded ", " kept "]


def test_quotes():
    assert split_csv_line('id, "Smith, John", "said ""ok"""') == ["id", "Smith, John", 'said "ok"']
    assert split_csv_line('"",""""') == ["", '"']


def test_errors():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        split_csv_line('a,"unterminated')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        split_csv_line('"a"b,c')


def test_regression_issue_1032():
    assert split_csv_line("a,,c,") == ["a", "c"]

acceptance/test_top_words.py.initial:
import pytest

from textkit.top_words import top_words


def test_counts_and_filters():
    text = "The launch: the 2024 launch, THE plan."
    assert top_words(text, 5) == [("the", 3), ("launch", 2), ("plan", 1)]
    assert top_words(text, 5, stopwords=["THE"]) == [("launch", 2), ("plan", 1)]
    assert top_words(text, 0) == []


def test_ties():
    assert top_words("zeta beta alpha beta zeta", 3) == [("beta", 2), ("zeta", 2), ("alpha", 1)]
    assert top_words("pear apple fig", 2) == [("apple", 1), ("fig", 1)]


def test_negative_k():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        top_words("a b", -1)


def test_regression_issue_918():
    assert top_words("pear apple fig", 2) == [("pear", 1), ("apple", 1)]
